name: Slant / Speed
note: Quick game. Slants inside, speed outs outside, and the center runs the fade to hold the deep middle.

name: Slant / Speed, Y Cross
note: Same routes. Y crosses to give a trips-left look. Watch who follows him.

name: Five Verticals
note: Everyone goes. Stretches every deep zone.

name: Flood Right
note: Three levels to the right: fade, out and the center in the flat.

name: Mesh
note: The slots cross at different depths while both outside men and the center clear deep.

name: Dagger
note: Y clears the seam, Z digs behind it, center sits underneath.

name: Mills
note: Z post with Y dig underneath attacks the deep middle.

name: Trips Smash
note: Comeback with a corner over the top on the three-receiver side.

name: Bunch Cross
note: Whip and jerk from the bunch cross, with the center on a dig.

name: Bunch Cross, B Exit
note: B motions out to the sideline before the snap.

name: Quads Layers
note: Four routes stacked at different depths on one side.

name: Tight Slants
note: Five slants from a compressed set.

name: Verticals, Z Enter
note: Z motions in toward the center before the snap.
